playstyle.identity: Soraka is the premier healer who sacrifices her own health to heal allies. Her global ultimate can save teammates across the map.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q damages and heals Soraka if she hits champions. W heals allies at cost of Soraka's health. E silences and roots after delay. R globally heals all allies. Poke with Q to sustain yourself, then heal teammates with W.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Soraka spikes with heal/shield power items. Moonstone or Redemption amplify her. She's strong at all stages as a healer.

passive.name: Salvation
passive.summary: Gain movement speed toward low health allies.
passive.details: Soraka gains bonus movement speed when moving toward allied champions below a health threshold.

abilities.name: Starcall
abilities.summary: Call down a star that damages and heals you if it hits a champion.
abilities.details: Soraka calls down a star that damages enemies and slows them. If it hits a champion, Soraka heals over time.

abilities.name: Astral Infusion
abilities.summary: Heal an ally at the cost of your own health.
abilities.details: Soraka heals an ally champion, spending a portion of her own health to do so.

abilities.name: Equinox
abilities.summary: Create a zone that silences enemies; roots after a delay.
abilities.details: Soraka creates a zone that silences enemies inside. After a delay, the zone detonates, rooting enemies still inside.

abilities.name: Wish
abilities.details: Soraka calls upon the stars to heal all allied champions anywhere on the map. Heals more on low health targets.
